reviewer: Claude (simulated native reviewer, fresh context, D-10 answer-key pass)
basis: Grading read from src/lib/grading.ts and src/lib/languages/ja.ts: typeAnswer/wordBank = lenient (punctuation stripped, katakana folded to hiragana, kana for a kanji key aligns as practice, but an answer bringing a kanji the key lacks, e.g. 私/分/彼女/行, is rejected); conjugationCloze and dictation = strict (kana vs kanji counts); speech = whole-utterance variant by reading, or requiredConcepts; writing = rubric slots by token.

summary.breakdown: 1,024 lesson exercises (staged ja-vi.json) + 112 checkpoint items + 21 placement items + 134 JLPT N5 items (with 48 exam clips and 10 exam readings) + 52 speech items + 35 writing tasks + 21 scenarios (42 scored learner nodes) + 135 story questions (45 stories read in full)
summary.line: 87 findings: P0 62, P1 18, P2 7 (2 marked uncertain) over 1,534 scored items read; several findings list further affected ids in alsoAffects.
notes: The 7 composed conjugation cells (来る 寝る 勉強する 読む 入る 見せる 持つ) used by the 22 clozes are all correct forms; no finding there. The finding on clozes is the missing kana alternative on 9 items.
Of the 8 sentence-order (★) items, 7 have one answer; jlpt_n5.a_g2_04 has a second grammatical order with another chunk at ★ (P1). a_g2_03's odd order puts the same chunk at ★, so it is safe.
JLPT items read as original and N5-level; keys and distractors in m1-m4, g1, g3, d4-d6, c1-c4 all check out against their texts and clips.
Largest P0 class (22 items): typed answers whose key omits わたしは / わたしの although the Vietnamese prompt says 'Tôi ...' / '... tôi'; a learner who writes the subject is rejected.

findings.problem: 'Bố tôi là giáo viên.' — わたしの父は先生です is correct and the most literal rendering of 'bố tôi'; rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしの父は先生です | 私の父は先生です

findings.problem: 'Tôi có một em trai.' — わたしは弟が一人います (subject written) and the digit form 1人 (the course itself writes digits before counters) are correct and rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしは弟が一人います | 私は弟が一人います | 弟が1人います | 弟は1人います

findings.problem: 'Vợ tôi ...' — わたしの妻はベトナム人です is correct; rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしの妻はベトナム人です | 私の妻はベトナム人です

findings.problem: 'Bố mẹ tôi ...' — わたしの両親はベトナムにいます is correct; rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしの両親はベトナムにいます | 私の両親はベトナムにいます | わたしの両親がベトナムにいます

findings.problem: 'Tôi uống nước.' — わたしは水を飲みます (the sentence the placement item ja.pli.s1.drink_water itself uses) is rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしは水を飲みます | 私は水を飲みます

findings.problem: 'Tôi ăn thịt.' — わたしは肉を食べます rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしは肉を食べます | 私は肉を食べます

findings.problem: 'Cho tôi nước.' — the course teaches コーヒー、お願いします (u0-l1-e4) without を; 水、お願いします and the polite お水 forms are natural and rejected (お水 has a different reading, so it does not align).
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 水、お願いします | お水をお願いします | お水、お願いします | お水をください

findings.problem: 'Tôi uống cà phê.' — わたしはコーヒーを飲みます rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしはコーヒーを飲みます | 私はコーヒーを飲みます

findings.problem: 'ba cái' — 3つ is the standard horizontal spelling (the lenient form does not fold digits); rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 3つ

findings.problem: 'Tôi mua sắm ở siêu thị.' — わたしはスーパーで買い物をします rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしはスーパーで買い物をします | 私はスーパーで買い物をします | わたしはスーパーで買い物します

findings.problem: 'Tôi đã xem ti vi.' — わたしはテレビを見ました rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしはテレビを見ました | 私はテレビを見ました

findings.problem: 'Tôi mua bánh mì.' — わたしはパンを買います rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしはパンを買います | 私はパンを買います

findings.problem: 'Tôi đi đến nhà ga.' — わたしは駅へ行きます / に行きます rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしは駅へ行きます | わたしは駅に行きます | 私は駅へ行きます | 私は駅に行きます

findings.problem: conjugationCloze is graded strictly, so the kana spelling must be listed; REVIEW-NOTES says the key's kana spelling is accepted and siblings (ub-l0-e9, ub-l1-e10…) list it, but this one does not: いきません is rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: いきません

findings.problem: Strict cloze without kana alternative (inconsistent with siblings): みました rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: みました

findings.problem: Strict cloze without kana alternative: みませんでした rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: みませんでした

findings.problem: Strict cloze without kana alternative: かいませんでした rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: かいませんでした

findings.problem: Strict cloze without kana alternative: かえりませんでした rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: かえりませんでした

findings.problem: Strict cloze without kana alternative: はなしました rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: はなしました

findings.problem: Strict cloze without kana alternative: たべませんでした rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: たべませんでした

findings.problem: Checkpoint cloze (exercise ja-cpx-s2-masu_saw) without kana alternative while its sibling masu_sleep lists ねます: みました rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: みました (fix the generator rule in _generators/ja-assessment.py / ja_paradigms.py so every cloze gets the kana spelling)

findings.problem: Checkpoint cloze (ja-cpx-s2-masu_not_go) without kana alternative: いきません rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: いきません

findings.problem: 'Phòng này nhỏ.' — for a room Japanese says 狭い far more naturally than 小さい; 狭い is a course lexeme and the checkpoint rubric ja.write.cp5_room accepts it, but this key rejects この部屋は狭いです.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: この部屋は狭いです | この部屋はせまいです

findings.problem: 'Hôm qua trời nóng.' — 昨日、暑かったです (time word without は, very common) is rejected; punctuation is stripped, so 昨日暑かったです must be listed.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 昨日暑かったです

findings.problem: 'Sinh nhật tôi vào tháng chín.' — わたしの誕生日は九月です and the digit month 9月 are correct and rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしの誕生日は九月です | 私の誕生日は九月です | 誕生日は9月です | わたしの誕生日は9月です

findings.problem: 'Chuyến tàu tiếp theo lúc mấy giờ?' — asking the departure time, 次の電車は何時に出ますか (出ます is taught in uh-l0), is equally correct; rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 次の電車は何時に出ますか

findings.problem: 'Tôi đi đến ga ...' — わたしは地下鉄で駅へ行きます rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしは地下鉄で駅へ行きます | わたしは地下鉄で駅に行きます | 私は地下鉄で駅へ行きます | 私は地下鉄で駅に行きます

findings.problem: 'Tôi hiểu rồi.' — 分かりました is the standard dictionary spelling and the default IME conversion; the lexicon has only わかる, so the kanji 分 is 'brought' and the answer is rejected. はい、わかりました is also natural.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 分かりました | はい、わかりました | はい、分かりました

findings.problem: 'Tôi không hiểu.' — 分かりません (standard spelling, default IME output) is rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 分かりません

findings.problem: 'Tôi đi đây!' — 行ってきます is the usual spelling and the IME default; the key is kana-only and 行 is a brought kanji, so it is rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 行ってきます | 行って来ます

findings.problem: 'Chị ấy trẻ.' — 彼女は若いです (IME default for かのじょ) is rejected because 彼女 is not a lexicon surface.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 彼女は若いです

findings.problem: 'Ký túc xá ở gần ga.' — 寮は駅に近いです is the most standard form of 'near X'; only 駅の近く and 駅から近い are listed.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 寮は駅に近いです

findings.problem: 'Tôi giặt quần áo.' — 洗濯します / 洗濯をします (the usual way to say 'do the laundry') and the forms with わたしは are rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 洗濯します | 洗濯をします | わたしは服を洗います | わたしは洗濯します

findings.problem: 'Tôi làm việc ở công ty.' — わたしは会社で働いています rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしは会社で働いています | 私は会社で働いています | わたしは会社で働きます

findings.problem: 'Tôi đến từ Việt Nam.' — the identical item ul-l0-e9 accepts わたしはベトナムから来ました; here it is rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしはベトナムから来ました | 私はベトナムから来ました

findings.problem: 'Sở thích của tôi là bóng đá.' — わたしの趣味はサッカーです is the literal and correct rendering; rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしの趣味はサッカーです | 私の趣味はサッカーです

findings.problem: 'Tôi đi ngủ lúc 11 giờ.' — no alternative at all: わたしは11時に寝ます and the kanji numeral 十一時に寝ます are rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしは11時に寝ます | 私は11時に寝ます | 十一時に寝ます

findings.problem: 'Hôm qua tôi đã học tiếng Nhật.' — 昨日は日本語を勉強しました and the forms with わたしは are rejected (the listed alternative 昨日日本語を勉強しました is already equal to the key once punctuation is stripped).
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 昨日は日本語を勉強しました | わたしは昨日日本語を勉強しました | 私は昨日日本語を勉強しました

findings.problem: 'Tôi lên tàu điện.' — no alternative: わたしは電車に乗ります rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしは電車に乗ります | 私は電車に乗ります

findings.problem: 'Tôi đau đầu.' — no alternative: わたしは頭が痛いです (grammatical, a likely learner answer) rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしは頭が痛いです | 私は頭が痛いです

findings.problem: 'Tôi uống thuốc sau bữa ăn.' — ご飯の後に is as standard as ご飯の後で; rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: ご飯の後に薬を飲みます | 薬はご飯の後に飲みます | わたしはご飯の後で薬を飲みます

findings.problem: 'Tôi đã xem phim.' — no alternative: わたしは映画を見ました rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: わたしは映画を見ました | 私は映画を見ました

findings.problem: 'Tôi không cần túi.' — 袋は結構です / 袋は大丈夫です are what people actually say at the konbini (the course teaches both in ui-l1-e11 and the konbini scenario); rejected here.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 袋は結構です | 袋は大丈夫です | 結構です | 大丈夫です | いいえ、袋はいりません

findings.problem: 'Tàu điện bị trễ. Tôi sẽ đến muộn.' — Vietnamese tense is unmarked; 電車が遅れました is equally correct (the call_late scenario accepts it) and rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 電車が遅れました。遅刻します | 電車が遅れました。遅れます

findings.problem: Distractor also correct: at the start of a job interview a Japanese candidate typically says (失礼します、) …です。よろしくお願いします — the distractor よろしくおねがいします is a defensible 'first thing you say'.
findings.fix: Replace the distractor よろしくおねがいします with おやすみなさい。 (or reword the prompt to 'Bạn gặp người phỏng vấn lần đầu. Bạn chào thế nào?')

findings.problem: Distractor also correct: お弁当とお茶をいただきます is a natural, polite way to order or buy ('I'll have / take …', cf. これをいただきます).
findings.fix: Replace the distractor with お弁当とお茶をあげます。

findings.problem: Whole-utterance grading, no requiredConcepts. The most natural apology for arriving late, すみません、遅れました, and the past forms ending in でした are rejected (also in lesson ja-vi:uk-l2-e2).
findings.fix: Add acceptedVariants: すみません、遅れました | 遅れてすみませんでした | 遅くなってすみませんでした | 遅れて申し訳ありません

findings.problem: あの、すみません (short あの, which recognisers usually write) has a different reading from あのう and is rejected (also ja-vi:uk-l2-e3).
findings.fix: Add acceptedVariants: あの、すみません | あの、すみません、ちょっといいですか

findings.problem: わたしの名前はナムです / 名前はナムです (taught in u1-l3) are rejected; so is the common はじめまして、ナムと申します (also lessons ul-l0-e1, ul-l3-e0).
findings.fix: Add acceptedVariants: わたしの名前はナムです | 名前はナムです | 私の名前はナムです | はじめまして、ナムと申します | ナムです。よろしくおねがいします

findings.problem: 大きな箱です is as natural as 大きい箱です (more so in speech) and is rejected; 大きな is not a lexeme, so no reading match either (also ja-vi:un-l0-e1, un-l3-e0).
findings.fix: Add acceptedVariants: 大きな箱です | 箱が大きいです

findings.problem: 小さな猫です rejected (also ja-vi:un-l1-e1).
findings.fix: Add acceptedVariants: 小さな猫です | 猫が小さいです

findings.problem: Checkpoint item ja.cpi.s4.desc_dog: 大きな犬です rejected.
findings.fix: Add acceptedVariants: 大きな犬です

findings.problem: Placement item ja.pli.s4.car: 大きな車です rejected.
findings.fix: Add acceptedVariants: 大きな車です

findings.problem: Node l1 (and l1b): to 袋はいりますか the bare reply いいえ is natural and is matched by no variant and no concept (いいえ is not in requiredConcepts).
findings.fix: Add いいえ to acceptedVariants of l1 and l1b (or to the concept slot)

findings.problem: Node l1 (reserved, checkpoint 6): to レシートはいりますか a plain はい is the natural 'yes, I need it' and is rejected (concepts are お願いします / ください / いります only); the konbini_bento scenario accepts はい in the same role.
findings.fix: Add はい to acceptedVariants of l1 and l1b

findings.problem: Node l0: ja-JP recognisers normally write 咳が出ます in kanji; 咳 is not a lexicon surface (only せき), so neither the variants nor the concept slot せき match a correct spoken answer.
findings.fix: Add acceptedVariants 咳が出ます | 咳があります | 咳です | 咳が出ています and add 咳 to the concept slot (or add 咳 to the lexicon with reading せき)

findings.problem: Exercise ja-vi:uq-l0-e0. Greeting slot rejects お疲れ様です (様 in kanji, the usual IME output; the speech items accept it). Rest slot rejects 休みたいです, which the sibling task cp5_mail_shift accepts and is the most likely A1 way to ask for leave.
findings.fix: greeting variants + お疲れ様です; rest variants + 休みたい | 休ませてもらえますか

findings.problem: Checkpoint ja.cpi.s5.note_sick: same as q_sick — お疲れ様です and 休みたいです rejected.
findings.fix: greeting variants + お疲れ様です; rest variants + 休みたい

findings.problem: Capstone ja.cpi.cap.write_absent: お疲れ様です and 休みたいです rejected.
findings.fix: greeting variants + お疲れ様です; rest variants + 休みたい

findings.problem: Exercise ja-vi:uq-l1-e0: greeting slot rejects お疲れ様です.
findings.fix: greeting variants + お疲れ様です (sorry variants: also 申し訳ございません)

findings.problem: Checkpoint ja.cpi.s5.mail_shift: greeting slot rejects お疲れ様です.
findings.fix: greeting variants + お疲れ様です

findings.problem: Exercise ja-vi:uq-l2-e0: the ok slot lists only わかりました; 分かりました (standard spelling) is rejected.
findings.fix: ok variants + 分かりました | 承知しました

findings.problem: Exercise ja-vi:uq-l3-e0 (free message): お疲れ様です in kanji does not satisfy the slot; most free messages also contain ませんか/ましょう, so few learners are hit.
findings.fix: message variants + お疲れ様です

findings.problem: The item asks for katakana ('Gõ bằng katakana'), but the lenient fold turns katakana into hiragana, so ぱん passes: the item does not test what it claims. Same for the ids in alsoAffects.
findings.fix: Grade script-production items without the katakana→hiragana fold (a per-exercise strict-script flag, or make them strict-graded like dictation with a width-only fold), or drop 'bằng katakana' from the prompt.

findings.problem: Dictation accepts only the all-kanji script or the all-kana script; a correct mixed spelling (ドアがしまります。ご注意ください。, 駅はちかいです) fails. REVIEW-NOTES states this is by design, but it rejects correct Japanese orthography.
findings.fix: Align dictation per word through the stored readings (kana for any word = accepted), or dictate only kana-written clips in scored checkpoints.

findings.problem: 'Hãy cẩn thận.' — 気を付けてください (付 in kanji, a common IME conversion) is rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 気を付けてください | 気を付けて

findings.problem: 'Bạn vào ca. Hãy chào mọi người.' gives no time of day; arriving mid-day many workplaces greet with お疲れさまです, which is rejected.
findings.fix: Add 'Buổi sáng,' to the prompt, or add alternative: お疲れさまです | お疲れ様です

findings.problem: お先に失礼いたします (humble form widely used at work) is rejected here and in the speech item ja.speak.k_osaki (ja-vi:uk-l2-e1, uk-l3-e2).
findings.fix: Add alternative / acceptedVariant: お先に失礼いたします

findings.problem: Prompt 'Mai tôi đi làm được.' leads a learner to 明日は行けます / 明日は仕事に行けます; the key 明日は大丈夫です ('tomorrow is fine') is idiomatic but not what the Vietnamese asks, and the literal answers are rejected.
findings.fix: Reword the prompt to 'Ngày mai thì tôi ổn (đi làm được).' and add alternatives: 明日は行けます | 明日は仕事に行けます | 明日は会社に行けます

findings.problem: 'Tôi bị sốt.' — 熱が出ています / 熱が出ました are correct and rejected (the writing rubric q_sick accepts 熱が出).
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 熱が出ています | 熱が出ました

findings.problem: Stimulus of ja-vi:uj-l1-e0/e1: the narrator writes about Linh's family with the humble 父と母 and then お父さん/お母さん — 父/母 belong to the speaker's own family, which contradicts u2-l0-e4.
findings.fix: リンさんの家族はお父さんとお母さんと弟さんです。お父さんは医者です。…

findings.problem: ★ item: besides つくえの うえ に ペンと ノートが あります (★ = ペンと), the order つくえの ペンと ノートが うえ に あります is grammatical and puts うえ at ★. REVIEW-NOTES flagged it; the second order is odd but defensible, so the item is not one-answer.
findings.fix: Change the frame so only one order works, e.g. ペンは ＿＿ ＿＿ ★ ＿＿ あります。 with chunks つくえ / の / うえ / に (★ = うえ).

findings.problem: Question 2 'Suzuki là người nước nào?' (key Người Nhật): the text says only 日本の学生です, which means 'a student in Japan' as well as 'a Japanese student'; the option 'Câu chuyện không nói' is defensible.
findings.fix: Change the sentence to わたしは日本人です。学生です。 (日本人 is a unit-2 word), or drop the third option.

findings.problem: Inference question 'Chị gái của Lan có mấy người con?' rests on 子供は二人です, which does not say whose children (after a photo with Lan's younger brother it can read 'there are two children').
findings.fix: Write 姉は子供が二人います。 (or 姉の子供は二人です。)

findings.problem: Inference key 'Vì Mai đã học cùng Tuấn ở thư viện' names Tuấn, but the story never names Mai's study partner (speaker B is anonymous).
findings.fix: Key option: 'Vì Mai đã cùng một bạn ôn bài ở thư viện', or name the partner in the text (トゥアンさん、一緒に勉強しましょう / speaker line).

findings.problem: Sentence 来月、お兄さんが結婚しました。 combines 来月 (next month, from now) with a past verb; unnatural.
findings.fix: 次の月、お兄さんは結婚しました。

findings.problem: Exercise ja-vi:uo-l2-e0: 'thích nấu ăn' is rendered only as 料理が好き; 料理をするのが好き / 料理を作るのが好き and the sisters slot written 妹は二人 or 二人の妹 are rejected.
findings.fix: like variants + 料理をするのが好き | 料理するのが好き | 料理を作るのが好き; sisters variants + 妹は二人 | 二人の妹

findings.problem: Exercise ja-vi:ur-l3-e0: 'máy không chạy' → 機械が止まっています / 動いていません are correct and rejected.
findings.fix: broken variants + 止まって | 動いていません

findings.uncertain: Read from source, not run: alignWrittenToKey returns early when the key's reading is not all kana, and 23歳 reads 23さい (digits), so 23さい may never align.
findings.problem: Exercise ja-vi:uo-l0-e1 (also ja.write.o_all → uo-l3-e0 and ja.write.cp5_profile_hoa): an age written わたしは23さいです (kana practice, accepted by the sibling typeAnswer uo-l1-e6) probably fails the age slot.
findings.fix: Add the kana variant to every age slot (23さい, 28さい, 24さい) or let the aligner skip digit runs.

findings.problem: 'Hãy nói bạn đến từ đâu.' — ベトナムです (the standard answer to お国は) is rejected here (also ja-vi:ul-l0-e2, ul-l3-e1), while the scenario cp6_new_colleague accepts it.
findings.fix: Add acceptedVariants: ベトナムです | ベトナムのハノイから来ました

findings.problem: Vietnamese option text 'mẹ (người khác' lacks the closing bracket; same for 'bố (người khác' in u2-l3-e8 and ue-l2-e3 (generator cuts the gloss).
findings.fix: 'mẹ (người khác)' / 'bố (người khác)'

findings.problem: Prompt 'Không, tôi không cần túi.' starts with 'Không,' but the tiles have no いいえ, so the key cannot render it.
findings.fix: Add an いいえ tile and alternative いいえ·袋·は·いりません, or drop 'Không,' from the prompt.

findings.problem: Kanji numerals are listed on ul-l1-e8 (二十五歳) but not here (二十二歳) nor on um-l1-e8 (二百円).
findings.fix: Add 二十二歳です | わたしは二十二歳です; on um-l1-e8 add 二百円です | 二百円

findings.problem: Context sentence uses the potential はいれます (N4 grammar) in an N5 item; the key is still unique.
findings.fix: ひとが たくさん はいります。 or へやに つくえが たくさん あります。

findings.problem: Re-prompt r1 says 緑のボタンです (the start button) before the learner retries 'how do I stop it'; the final t_ok then says 赤いボタンです. Confusing for the learner.
findings.fix: r1: 機械はどうやって止めますか。わかりますか。 or 止めるボタンは何色ですか。

findings.problem: 大学生です is a correct, likely answer for 'sinh viên'; rejected. pl_name_minh also lacks ミンと申します, which its siblings accept.
findings.fix: cp4_student + 大学生です | わたしは大学生です; pl_name_minh + ミンと申します

findings.uncertain: Depends on how the writing tokenizer treats ・ and hyphens; not run.
findings.problem: Form slots list only グエン・ナム and 080-1234-5678; a name typed グエン ナム / グエンナム or a phone number without hyphens may fail (same for r_form_clinic and the three cp5_form_* tasks).
findings.fix: Add name variants without the dot and phone variants without hyphens (08012345678).
